Definition: from G1537 and the base of G160; of a sudden (unexpectedly):--suddenly. Compare G1819.
BiblicalUsage: exaíphnēs means suddenly, unexpectedly. In Mark 13:36, the text says "Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping." In Luke 2:13, the text says "And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God."
TheologicalSignificance: exaíphnēs convinces me that God's judgment is just, and it falls where it should — no one escapes it, and no one suffers it unjustly. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; The Conversion of Paul; The Healing of the Demon-Possessed Boy
